mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_config ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM system_config WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT DISTINCT category FROM system_config ORDER BY category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config (config_key, config_value, category, label, description, value_type, is_sensitive, is_restart_required, sort_order) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{category}, #{label}, #{description}, #{valueType}, #{isSensitive}, #{isRestartRequired}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, label = #{label}, description = #{description}, value_type = #{valueType}, is_sensitive = #{isSensitive}, is_restart_required = #{isRestartRequired}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
MERGE INTO system_config (config_key, config_value) KEY (config_key) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue})
INSERT INTO system_config (config_key, config_value) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
